panels.description: CPU requests vs allocatable capacity per node

targets.expr: sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"}) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"}) * 100

panels.title: CPU Requests Commitment per Node (%)

panels.description: Memory requests vs allocatable capacity per node

targets.expr: sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"}) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"}) * 100

panels.title: Memory Requests Commitment per Node (%)
